::: landscape-annex

# Annex 1: Results by forest type and region {.unnumbered}

Estimates for each forest type within each administrative region. Many domains have few plots and the estimates are indicative only. ME is not given for domains with a single plot. Definitions are in @sec-results.

## Forest area {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| results: asis
print_annex(tab$a_area, "area", "Area of forest types")
```

## Tree species composition and diversity {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| results: asis
print_annex(tab$b_ivi_species, "ivi-species", "Top 20 species by Importance Value Index", .drop = c("n_pp", "density_mep", "n_sections"))
print_annex(tab$b_ivi_genus, "ivi-genus", "Top 10 genera by Importance Value Index", .drop = c("n_pp", "density_mep", "n_sections"))
print_annex(tab$b_ivi_family, "ivi-family", "Top 10 families by Importance Value Index", .drop = c("n_pp", "density_mep", "n_sections"))
print_annex(tab$b_shannon, "shannon", "Shannon diversity index")
```

## Rare, threatened and endangered tree species {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| results: asis
print_annex(tab$c_iucn, "iucn", "Tree species in the IUCN Red List threatened categories", .drop = "tree_iucn_category")
```
